content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 reflects missing required authorization; retroactive authorization and peer-to-peer review are unavailable, and correcting otherwise valid claim data would not address the denial. Although an appeal was previously attempted, the denial remains actionable and the published rules do not prohibit another medical-necessity appeal. This remains an available payer-recovery route without improperly transferring the full balance to the patient or requiring escalation.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
